completeCard.name: Arcane Bolt
completeCard.effect: Arcane Bolt. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, universal, damage. Make a Wizard spell attack. On a hit deal S d6 + M force damage. Arcane Bolt is an always-prepared class matrix once acquired and uses the normal first-distinct-matrix and Refrain rules.

source.originalText: Arcane Bolt: Launch a bolt of pure arcane energy that deals force damage to a single target.

completeCard.name: Arcane Shield
completeCard.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
completeCard.effect: Arcane Shield. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, abjuration, protection. Trigger when an attack roll would hit you. Gain +2 AC against the triggering attack and until the start of your next regular turn, potentially causing the attack to miss. Temporary AC from another Arcane Shield does not stack.

source.originalText: Arcane Shield: Create a barrier of magical force that provides temporary protection.

completeCard.name: Arcane Insight
completeCard.effect: Arcane Insight. Tags: base, passive, knowledge. Gain proficiency in Arcana, or expertise if already proficient. When examining an active magical effect, spell residue, magic item or arcane construction, you may make an Intelligence (Arcana) check to determine its broad school, function or unusual matrix behavior. The Director sets the normal knowledge DC; failure supplies no invented fact.

source.originalText: Arcane Insight: Identify magical effects and items with greater accuracy than non-wizards.

completeCard.name: Spell Scribing
completeCard.effect: Spell Scribing. Tags: base, passive, spellbook. Copying a legal found Wizard spell into your spellbook requires 1 hour and 25 gp of inks and components per spell rank, treating rank 0 as rank 1 for this calculation, instead of the pilot baseline 2 hours and 50 gp. Level-up spells remain free.

source.originalText: Spell Scribing: Copy spells into your spellbook at half the normal cost and time.

completeCard.name: Spellbook Study
completeCard.effect: Spellbook Study. Tags: base, active, matrix, ritual. Replace one currently prepared matrix with one legal spell recorded in your spellbook. The replacement must be within your Wizard rank limit. This is the normal midday substitution permission; it does not alter the spellbook, create another prepared-matrix position or reset first-cast/Refrain history for an underlying matrix family already cast this encounter.

source.originalText: Spellbook Study: Spend time studying your spellbook to prepare a different selection of spells.

completeCard.name: Scholarly Mind
completeCard.effect: Scholarly Mind. Tags: base, passive, knowledge. You have advantage on Intelligence checks whose primary purpose is recalling, researching or analyzing arcane theory, magical history, planar magical principles or constructed spell formulae. It does not grant advantage on spell attacks, Counterspell checks or general Investigation unrelated to arcane scholarship.

source.originalText: Scholarly Mind: Gain advantage on Intelligence checks related to arcane knowledge.

completeCard.name: Arcane Sight
completeCard.effect: Arcane Sight. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, divination, concentration. While active you perceive magical auras within 60 feet and automatically know each visible aura's school or broad magical category. As an Action on a later turn, examine one aura to learn whether it is concentrated, summoned, cursed, warded or linked to another visible magical effect. Total cover blocks sight.

source.originalText: Arcane Sight: See magical auras and effects for a short duration.

completeCard.name: Sigil Rewrite
completeCard.effect: Sigil Rewrite. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, matrix. Replace one prepared matrix with a different spell from your spellbook of exactly the same rank without performing the normal 10-minute ritual. The replacement receives no special Dissonance reset for a matrix family already used this encounter and must obey current Wizard rank eligibility.

source.originalText: Sigil Rewrite: Once/day, instantly swap a spell you know for another of the same tier

automaticCards.name: Arcane Tradition
automaticCards.frequency: Automatic at Wizard 3; not a selection
automaticCards.effect: Arcane Tradition. Tags: arch, school, automatic. Your level-1 Arcane School becomes your Arcanist tradition; do not choose a second school. Prepare one additional matrix from that same school each day without counting it against your normal prepared-matrix maximum. It otherwise obeys all ordinary rank, spellbook, Dissonance and duplicate-family rules.

source.originalText: Arcane Tradition: Choose a school of magic to specialize in, gaining bonuses to spells of that school.

automaticCards.name: Counterspell
automaticCards.rangeAndTarget: One creature you perceive casting a spell within 60 feet
automaticCards.effect: Counterspell. Tags: arch-source, automatic, wizard-spell, abjuration, disruption. Trigger when a creature begins casting a spell. Make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + twice the spell's rank, treating rank 0 as 0. Success negates the triggering spell after its costs are paid; failure lets it resolve. This is gained automatically at Wizard 2 and is never also selected from the Arch pool.

source.originalText: Counterspell: Disrupt an enemy's spellcasting, potentially negating their spell entirely.

automaticCards.name: Ritual Casting
automaticCards.cost: 0 RP unless the individual ritual explicitly states otherwise
automaticCards.frequency: At will outside encounters with sufficient time
automaticCards.effect: Source progression line 5184. Cast a Wizard spell bearing the Ritual tag directly from your spellbook without preparing it. Increase its casting time by at least 10 minutes. Ritual Casting cannot be completed during an encounter, does not use an ordinary prepared-matrix position and does not generate or vent normal casting Dissonance.

source.originalText: | 2 | Counterspell Reaction, Ritual Casting |

completeCard.name: Matrix Efficiency
completeCard.effect: Matrix Efficiency. Tags: base, passive, matrix. Your normal full daily Spell Matrix preparation time is reduced from 1 hour to 45 minutes. This does not reduce the separate 10-minute midday substitution ritual, spell scribing, rituals or spellbook reconstruction unless another feature explicitly says so.

source.originalText: Matrix Efficiency: Reduce the preparation time for spells by 25%.

completeCard.name: Matrix Mastery
completeCard.effect: Matrix Mastery. Tags: arch, passive, matrix. During preparation you may assign at most one common Matrix Mastery modification to each ordinary prepared spell: Quick Substitution, Component Enhancement, Matrix Linking or Stability Reinforcement, using the exact common definitions in the Wizard engine. Always-prepared class-card matrices cannot receive these modifications unless a card explicitly says otherwise.

source.originalText: Matrix Mastery: Modify spell matrices to change minor aspects of prepared spells.

completeCard.name: Floating Preparation
completeCard.effect: Floating Preparation. Tags: arch, passive, matrix. Increase your maximum prepared Spell Matrix count by 1. The extra matrix can come from any school and obeys all ordinary spellbook and rank restrictions. It is a prepared matrix for every rule, including protected strain, duplicate-family tracking and Matrix Mastery modifications.

source.originalText: Floating Preparation: Prepare 1 extra spell from any school each day

completeCard.name: Spell Tether
completeCard.effect: Spell Tether. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, concentration, tether. When you begin a second concentration spell that targets only yourself while already concentrating on a self-only spell, spend 3 additional RP. For up to 3 rounds you may maintain both. Whenever damage requires a concentration save, make one save; failure ends BOTH spells. Starting a third concentration effect ends both tethered spells before the new one begins. Spell Tether and Tethered Cast cannot be combined; maximum two sustained concentration effects total. Only one Spell Tether can exist at a time.

source.originalText: Spell Tether: Maintain 2 self-buff spells without concentration (1/rest)

completeCard.name: Improved Concentration
completeCard.effect: Improved Concentration. Tags: arch, passive, concentration. You have advantage on Constitution saving throws made because damage threatens your concentration on a Wizard spell. This does not alter the DC, protect a Tether from rules that explicitly end both effects, or prevent Silence, incapacitation and other non-damage concentration failures.

source.originalText: Improved Concentration: Advantage on concentration checks when taking damage.

completeCard.name: Dispel Magic
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: One creature, object or magical effect within 60 feet
completeCard.effect: Dispel Magic. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, abjuration. Choose one ongoing spell effect you can perceive. If its rank is 3 or lower, end it. If it is rank 4 or higher, make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + spell rank; success ends it. Permanent artifact properties and effects explicitly immune to dispelling are unaffected.

source.originalText: Dispel Magic: End magical effects in an area or on a target.

completeCard.name: Spell Preservation
completeCard.effect: Spell Preservation. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive, spellbook. Your primary spellbook cannot be destroyed, erased or rendered permanently unreadable by non-artifact mundane or magical means. It can still be stolen, hidden, transported, suppressed, sealed by an artifact-level effect or voluntarily abandoned. Copies and backup books do not automatically receive this protection.

source.originalText: Spell Preservation: Your spellbook cannot be destroyed by non-artifact means.

completeCard.name: Seal Magic
completeCard.effect: Seal Magic. Tags: hero, spellbinder, wizard-spell, control. Choose one of the eight schools and target one creature. It makes a Wisdom save. On failure it cannot cast spells of the chosen school. At the end of each of its turns it repeats the save, ending the Seal on success. The effect ends automatically after 3 rounds and never prevents non-spell class techniques merely because they are magical.

source.originalText: Seal Magic: Prevent a target from casting spells of a specific school (WIS save, 3 rounds)

completeCard.name: Arcane Lock
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: One door, chest, portal or unattended object within touch
completeCard.effect: Arcane Lock. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, abjuration. Magically seal the target. Opening it without your permission requires a Strength check or thieves'/arcane-tool check against your Wizard spell DC. Dispel Magic can end the lock. You can designate up to M creatures who can bypass it. This does not make the object physically indestructible.

source.originalText: Arcane Lock: Create a magical barrier that prevents entry or access to an object or area.

completeCard.name: Knowledge Shield
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: Allies directly protected by one of your Abjuration Wizard spells
completeCard.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
completeCard.frequency: At most once per ally per round
completeCard.effect: Knowledge Shield. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive, protection. When you cast an Abjuration spell that grants AC, temporary HP, resistance or a saving-throw benefit to an ally, that ally also gains +2 on its next saving throw before the start of your next regular turn. Multiple Knowledge Shields do not stack.

source.originalText: Knowledge Shield: When you cast a protective spell, allies gain +2 to saving throws.

completeCard.name: Dimensional Pocket
completeCard.effect: Dimensional Pocket. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, conjuration, ritual. Create an extradimensional storage space holding up to 100 pounds or 10 cubic feet of unattended nonliving material. Retrieving or placing an item while adjacent to the opening uses an object interaction. Living creatures cannot enter. When duration ends, remaining contents appear harmlessly in the nearest unoccupied space.

source.originalText: Dimensional Pocket: Create a small extradimensional space to store items.

source.originalText: | 5 | Bonus Feat: School Mastery |

automaticCards.name: Arcane Ward
automaticCards.effect: Source progression line 5187. After preparing spells, choose one of acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, psychic, radiant or thunder that is dealt by at least one prepared spell of your Arcane School. Gain resistance to that damage type until your next long rest. If none of your prepared school spells deals a damage type, choose force. This is provisional completion of the source's ambiguous 'chosen school's element' wording.

source.originalText: | 6 | Arcane Ward (resistance to chosen school's element) |

automaticCards.name: Dual Cast
automaticCards.cost: Pay the complete RP costs of both spells
automaticCards.effect: Source progression line 5188. Choose two DIFFERENT prepared Wizard spells of rank 1 or 2, neither of which summons a creature or grants an additional Action. Cast both sequentially as one Action, paying both RP costs. They cannot both require concentration. Each matrix separately updates first-cast/Refrain history. Features that trigger merely from 'casting a spell' may trigger once for each actual matrix unless that feature itself says once per turn; no trigger may create another Dual Cast or additional full Action.

source.originalText: | 9 | Dual Cast (cast 2 Tier 1–2 spells in a round) |

automaticCards.name: Overchannel
automaticCards.cost: Pay the Core V 2 RP cost for one rank above the spell's normal cast rank
automaticCards.rangeAndTarget: One prepared spell you are beginning to cast
automaticCards.effect: Source progression line 5190. Cast one prepared spell as though it were one rank higher than the highest rank at which you could normally cast that SAME spell, provided the spell has an explicit higher-rank scaling rule. Overchannel does not teach or prepare a higher-rank spell, cannot exceed effective rank 9 and cannot be combined with another generic Overcast rule during this pilot. All normal Dissonance/Refrain rules still apply.

source.originalText: | 13 | Overchannel (cast a spell 1 tier higher once/day) |

source.originalText: Arcane Sight: See magical auras and effects for a short duration.

completeCard.name: Sigil Rewrite
completeCard.effect: Sigil Rewrite. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, matrix. Replace one prepared matrix with a different spell from your spellbook of exactly the same rank without performing the normal 10-minute ritual. The replacement receives no special Dissonance reset for a matrix family already used this encounter and must obey current Wizard rank eligibility.

source.originalText: Sigil Rewrite: Once/day, instantly swap a spell you know for another of the same tier

completeCard.name: Matrix Efficiency
completeCard.effect: Matrix Efficiency. Tags: base, passive, matrix. Your normal full daily Spell Matrix preparation time is reduced from 1 hour to 45 minutes. This does not reduce the separate 10-minute midday substitution ritual, spell scribing, rituals or spellbook reconstruction unless another feature explicitly says so.

source.originalText: Matrix Efficiency: Reduce the preparation time for spells by 25%.

completeCard.name: Matrix Mastery
completeCard.effect: Matrix Mastery. Tags: arch, passive, matrix. During preparation you may assign at most one common Matrix Mastery modification to each ordinary prepared spell: Quick Substitution, Component Enhancement, Matrix Linking or Stability Reinforcement, using the exact common definitions in the Wizard engine. Always-prepared class-card matrices cannot receive these modifications unless a card explicitly says otherwise.

source.originalText: Matrix Mastery: Modify spell matrices to change minor aspects of prepared spells.

completeCard.name: Floating Preparation
completeCard.effect: Floating Preparation. Tags: arch, passive, matrix. Increase your maximum prepared Spell Matrix count by 1. The extra matrix can come from any school and obeys all ordinary spellbook and rank restrictions. It is a prepared matrix for every rule, including protected strain, duplicate-family tracking and Matrix Mastery modifications.

source.originalText: Floating Preparation: Prepare 1 extra spell from any school each day

completeCard.name: Spell Tether
completeCard.effect: Spell Tether. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, concentration, tether. When you begin a second concentration spell that targets only yourself while already concentrating on a self-only spell, spend 3 additional RP. For up to 3 rounds you may maintain both. Whenever damage requires a concentration save, make one save; failure ends BOTH spells. Starting a third concentration effect ends both tethered spells before the new one begins. Spell Tether and Tethered Cast cannot be combined; maximum two sustained concentration effects total. Only one Spell Tether can exist at a time.

source.originalText: Spell Tether: Maintain 2 self-buff spells without concentration (1/rest)

completeCard.name: Improved Concentration
completeCard.effect: Improved Concentration. Tags: arch, passive, concentration. You have advantage on Constitution saving throws made because damage threatens your concentration on a Wizard spell. This does not alter the DC, protect a Tether from rules that explicitly end both effects, or prevent Silence, incapacitation and other non-damage concentration failures.

source.originalText: Improved Concentration: Advantage on concentration checks when taking damage.

completeCard.name: Dispel Magic
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: One creature, object or magical effect within 60 feet
completeCard.effect: Dispel Magic. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, abjuration. Choose one ongoing spell effect you can perceive. If its rank is 3 or lower, end it. If it is rank 4 or higher, make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + spell rank; success ends it. Permanent artifact properties and effects explicitly immune to dispelling are unaffected.

source.originalText: Dispel Magic: End magical effects in an area or on a target.

completeCard.name: Flesh Ascendant
completeCard.effect: Flesh Ascendant. Tags: hero, necromancer, passive, undead. Each undead creature you control gains +2 maximum HP per Wizard class level. While at least two of your undead creatures are active, each also gains +1 AC and +1 on saving throws. These bonuses apply after the common standard-minion and elite-pet statistics and do not increase companion caps or command frequency.

source.originalText: Flesh Ascendant: All undead gain +2 HP per Wizard level, if 2+ undead are active, gain +1 AC and Save

completeCard.name: Corpse Harvest
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: One eligible humanoid corpse within 30 feet
completeCard.duration: Until destroyed, dismissed or your next long rest
completeCard.effect: Corpse Harvest. Tags: hero, necromancer, wizard-spell, undead, summon. Raise the corpse as a Skeleton or Zombie using the common standard-undead statistics; a goblinoid corpse may instead become a Goblin Thrall. The corpse is consumed into that minion state. The creature obeys the shared Bonus Action Companion Command rule. Creating a fourth standard minion requires dismissing one existing standard minion first.

source.originalText: Corpse Harvest: Raise skeletons/goblins/zombies from slain humanoids

completeCard.name: Arcane Lock
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: One door, chest, portal or unattended object within touch
completeCard.effect: Arcane Lock. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, abjuration. Magically seal the target. Opening it without your permission requires a Strength check or thieves'/arcane-tool check against your Wizard spell DC. Dispel Magic can end the lock. You can designate up to M creatures who can bypass it. This does not make the object physically indestructible.

source.originalText: Arcane Lock: Create a magical barrier that prevents entry or access to an object or area.

completeCard.name: Mind Matrix
completeCard.effect: Mind Matrix. Tags: hero, necromancer, passive, enchantment. Increase your Wizard save DC by 2 for Enchantment spells. This stacks with your level-1 school bonus only if Enchantment is your Arcane School. It does not increase DCs for non-spell class techniques merely because they influence a creature's mind.

source.originalText: Mind Matrix: Your enchantment spells are harder to resist (+2 to save DC).

completeCard.name: Dimensional Pocket
completeCard.effect: Dimensional Pocket. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, conjuration, ritual. Create an extradimensional storage space holding up to 100 pounds or 10 cubic feet of unattended nonliving material. Retrieving or placing an item while adjacent to the opening uses an object interaction. Living creatures cannot enter. When duration ends, remaining contents appear harmlessly in the nearest unoccupied space.

source.originalText: Dimensional Pocket: Create a small extradimensional space to store items.

automaticCards.name: Arcane Tradition
automaticCards.frequency: Automatic at Wizard 3; not a selection
automaticCards.effect: Arcane Tradition. Tags: arch, school, automatic. Your level-1 Arcane School becomes your Arcanist tradition; do not choose a second school. Prepare one additional matrix from that same school each day without counting it against your normal prepared-matrix maximum. It otherwise obeys all ordinary rank, spellbook, Dissonance and duplicate-family rules.

source.originalText: Arcane Tradition: Choose a school of magic to specialize in, gaining bonuses to spells of that school.

automaticCards.name: Counterspell
automaticCards.rangeAndTarget: One creature you perceive casting a spell within 60 feet
automaticCards.effect: Counterspell. Tags: arch-source, automatic, wizard-spell, abjuration, disruption. Trigger when a creature begins casting a spell. Make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + twice the spell's rank, treating rank 0 as 0. Success negates the triggering spell after its costs are paid; failure lets it resolve. This is gained automatically at Wizard 2 and is never also selected from the Arch pool.

source.originalText: Counterspell: Disrupt an enemy's spellcasting, potentially negating their spell entirely.

automaticCards.name: Ritual Casting
automaticCards.cost: 0 RP unless the individual ritual explicitly states otherwise
automaticCards.frequency: At will outside encounters with sufficient time
automaticCards.effect: Source progression line 5184. Cast a Wizard spell bearing the Ritual tag directly from your spellbook without preparing it. Increase its casting time by at least 10 minutes. Ritual Casting cannot be completed during an encounter, does not use an ordinary prepared-matrix position and does not generate or vent normal casting Dissonance.

source.originalText: | 2 | Counterspell Reaction, Ritual Casting |

automaticCards.name: School Mastery
automaticCards.effect: Source progression line 5186. This is the one School Mastery progression grant, not a second school choice or duplicate feat. Increase the level-1 Arcane School spell-attack and spell-save bonus from +1 to +2 total. Its school passive and bonus-spell rules otherwise remain unchanged.

source.originalText: | 5 | Bonus Feat: School Mastery |

automaticCards.name: Arcane Ward
automaticCards.effect: Source progression line 5187. After preparing spells, choose one of acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, psychic, radiant or thunder that is dealt by at least one prepared spell of your Arcane School. Gain resistance to that damage type until your next long rest. If none of your prepared school spells deals a damage type, choose force. This is provisional completion of the source's ambiguous 'chosen school's element' wording.

source.originalText: | 6 | Arcane Ward (resistance to chosen school's element) |

automaticCards.name: Dual Cast
automaticCards.cost: Pay the complete RP costs of both spells
automaticCards.effect: Source progression line 5188. Choose two DIFFERENT prepared Wizard spells of rank 1 or 2, neither of which summons a creature or grants an additional Action. Cast both sequentially as one Action, paying both RP costs. They cannot both require concentration. Each matrix separately updates first-cast/Refrain history. Features that trigger merely from 'casting a spell' may trigger once for each actual matrix unless that feature itself says once per turn; no trigger may create another Dual Cast or additional full Action.

source.originalText: | 9 | Dual Cast (cast 2 Tier 1–2 spells in a round) |

automaticCards.name: Overchannel
automaticCards.cost: Pay the Core V 2 RP cost for one rank above the spell's normal cast rank
automaticCards.rangeAndTarget: One prepared spell you are beginning to cast
automaticCards.effect: Source progression line 5190. Cast one prepared spell as though it were one rank higher than the highest rank at which you could normally cast that SAME spell, provided the spell has an explicit higher-rank scaling rule. Overchannel does not teach or prepare a higher-rank spell, cannot exceed effective rank 9 and cannot be combined with another generic Overcast rule during this pilot. All normal Dissonance/Refrain rules still apply.

source.originalText: | 13 | Overchannel (cast a spell 1 tier higher once/day) |

completeCard.name: Serum Injection
completeCard.frequency: At will while legal doses remain
completeCard.effect: Serum Injection. Choose one equipped mutation and one prepared serum dose. Consume the dose, activate that mutation for 3 rounds and apply the serum profile for 3 rounds. Observe active-mutation limits, Strain legality and nonstacking same-profile bonuses.

source.originalText: Serum Injection: Activate a prepared mutation serum as a bonus action, triggering its effects for 3 rounds.

completeCard.name: Brutal Strike
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: One creature within your weapon reach
completeCard.duration: Instantaneous; Stagger until end of target's next turn
completeCard.effect: Brutal Strike. Make one melee weapon attack using its normal ability. On hit add S d6 damage of the weapon's type. The target makes a Constitution save; on failure it is Staggered, taking -1 on attack rolls and -5 feet Speed until the end of its next turn. This is not a full-turn denial.

source.originalText: Brutal Strike: A powerful attack that deals additional damage based on your Strength and has a chance to stagger the target.

completeCard.name: Mutation Adaptation
completeCard.effect: Mutation Adaptation. Ignore the Strain-2 Speed penalty. The first time in each encounter that activating a mutation or serum would add Strain, reduce that Strain gain by 1, minimum 0. This reduction cannot reduce Serum Cocktail or Mutation Overload below 1 Strain and cannot reduce existing Strain.

source.originalText: Mutation Adaptation: Your body has been conditioned to accept mutations with reduced side effects.

completeCard.name: Serum Tolerance
completeCard.effect: Serum Tolerance. Negative side effects printed on serum profiles do not affect you. Strain generation and Strain penalties still apply normally. This does not suppress drawbacks printed on mutation cards, Hero transformations or Mutation Overload.

source.originalText: Serum Tolerance: You can consume serums without the normal toxicity effects that would affect others.

completeCard.name: Mutation Surge
completeCard.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
completeCard.effect: Mutation Surge. Enhance one active mutation. If it grants AC, DR, attack, save or flat damage, increase one such bonus by 1; if it grants movement or reach, increase it by 5 feet; if it deals mutation damage, add 1d4 to one damage event. A mutation with none of those numeric effects instead grants S temporary HP. The enhancement never changes immunity, target count or duration.

source.originalText: Mutation Surge: Temporarily enhance an active mutation, increasing its effects for 1 round but adding strain to your body.

completeCard.name: Intimidating Presence
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies of your choice within 15 feet that can see or hear you
completeCard.effect: Intimidating Presence. Each target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it is Frightened of you until the end of its next turn, then repeats the save. A second failure extends the fear one final round. A creature that succeeds becomes immune to this use. This never forces surrender; NPC surrender remains a Director decision.

source.originalText: Intimidating Presence: Use your mutated appearance to frighten enemies, potentially causing them to flee or surrender.

completeCard.name: Mutation Overload
completeCard.duration: 2 rounds; backlash until end of following turn
completeCard.effect: Mutation Overload. For 2 rounds, enhance each currently active mutation once: an AC, DR, attack, save or flat-damage bonus increases by 1; a movement or reach bonus increases by 5 feet; or one mutation damage/healing roll gains +1d4. Immunities, target counts, resource generation and action grants cannot be increased. When Overload ends, you suffer -1 on attack rolls and saving throws and -5 feet Speed until the end of your next regular turn. This activation is illegal if +2 Strain would exceed the Strain cap.

source.originalText: Mutation Overload: Push your mutations beyond safe limits, gaining significantly enhanced effects for 2 rounds followed by exhaustion.

completeCard.name: Mutation Efficiency
completeCard.effect: Mutation Efficiency. You may maintain up to two equipped mutations active simultaneously instead of one. Activating a third mutation while two are already active requires choosing one active mutation to become dormant unless another explicit feature temporarily raises this limit. Mutation slots, serum costs, Strain and mutation durations remain unchanged.

source.originalText: Mutation Efficiency: May have 2 active mutations at once (Lv 3)

completeCard.name: Combat Instinct
completeCard.effect: Combat Instinct. Gain +1 on initiative rolls. You cannot be Surprised while conscious unless the opposing creature's Stealth check exceeds your passive Perception by 5 or more. This does not grant extra Actions or movement before combat.

source.originalText: Combat Instinct: +5% initiative and +10% resistance to being surprised.

completeCard.name: Brutality Sense
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: Hostile creatures you can perceive within 60 feet
completeCard.effect: Brutality Sense. You know when a visible hostile creature is at or below one-quarter of its maximum HP; it is Vulnerable for your Warrior features that specifically reference a marked vulnerable target. This does not reveal its exact HP or hidden resistances.

source.originalText: Brutality Sense: You can sense when an opponent is below 25% health, marking them as vulnerable.

completeCard.name: Crushing Advance
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: Self; 20-foot straight movement path and creatures crossed or approached within 5 feet
completeCard.effect: Crushing Advance. Move up to 20 feet in a straight line without provoking opportunity attacks. Each enemy no more than one size larger whose space or reach-line you pass through or adjacent to makes a Strength save. On failure it takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage, is pushed to the nearest legal space outside your path and falls Prone. On success it takes half damage and is neither pushed nor Prone. A creature is affected once per use.

source.originalText: Crushing Advance: Once per long rest, move in a straight line up to 20 ft, knocking aside all enemies (STR save or fall prone, take 2d6)

completeCard.name: Survival Instinct
completeCard.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
completeCard.effect: Survival Instinct. Gain +2 on Perception checks, +2 on Dexterity saving throws and one additional Reaction usable only for Dodge-like defensive reactions, opportunity-free movement granted by a feature, or Deflect-style mitigation. It cannot make an attack or trigger another additional Reaction.

source.originalText: Survival Instinct: Enter a heightened state of awareness, gaining bonuses to perception and reaction time for a short duration.

completeCard.name: Serum Cocktail
completeCard.cost: Consume 2 different prepared serum doses; +2 Strain
completeCard.effect: Serum Cocktail. Choose two different prepared serum profiles, consume both doses and apply both profiles to yourself for 3 rounds while activating one eligible equipped mutation. Same-stat bonuses use only the stronger value. Both profile side effects apply unless Serum Tolerance suppresses them. This activates only one mutation and therefore differs from Serum Overclock. It is illegal if the resulting Strain would exceed 3.

source.originalText: Serum Cocktail: Combine two different serums for a hybrid effect, though with increased strain on your body.

completeCard.name: Intimidating Transformation
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies of your choice within 20 feet that can see you
completeCard.effect: Intimidating Transformation. Each target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it is Frightened of you until the end of its next turn and then repeats the save. On a failure by 10 or more, it would instead be Stunned until the end of its next turn, subject to the Warrior hard-control guard. A target succeeding on the initial save is immune to this use. The transformation does not force surrender or belief changes.

source.originalText: Intimidating Transformation: Undergo a particularly terrifying mutation that can cause enemies to become frightened or even paralyzed with fear.

completeCard.name: Guardian Tissue
completeCard.effect: Guardian Tissue. When an adjacent ally would take damage, reduce that ally's incoming damage by one-third rounded down. You take the prevented amount as damage of the same type. This transferred damage cannot be redirected again and cannot trigger another Guardian Tissue. Transferred damage cannot be reduced again, redirected again or generate BT.

source.originalText: Guardian Tissue: When an adjacent ally would take damage, you can absorb 30% of it as a reaction.

completeCard.name: Bulwark Mutation Tree
completeCard.effect: Bulwark Mutation Tree. Unlock the Wardborn-specific mutations Spinal Plating, Adrenal Overwatch and Living Cover as eligible mutation choices. They occupy normal mutation slots, require serum activation unless their card says otherwise, and obey all active-mutation, tier and Strain rules. Selecting this card does not automatically equip or activate any of them.

source.originalText: Bulwark Mutation Tree: Unlocks mutations like:

completeCard.name: Mutation Slot I
completeCard.effect: Gain one mutation slot. During a completed short or long rest, equip one eligible mutation in it. The equipped mutation remains dormant until activated unless its own text says otherwise.

source.originalText: | 1 | Mutation Slot I (choose 1), Brutality Threshold (BT) tracker |

completeCard.name: Brutality Threshold Tracker
completeCard.effect: Track Brutality Progress and BT using the common Warrior engine. Default BT cap is 3. Encounter end resets both to 0.

source.originalText: | 1 | Mutation Slot I (choose 1), Brutality Threshold (BT) tracker |

completeCard.name: Mutagen Injection
completeCard.effect: Choose Power or Guard. Power grants +2 Strength, maximum 22 from this feature. Guard grants +2 AC. This emergency mutagen does not consume a prepared serum dose and does not activate a mutation.

source.originalText: | 2 | Mutagen Injection (1/rest: +2 STR or +2 AC for 3 rounds) |

completeCard.name: Mutation Slot II
completeCard.effect: Gain a second mutation slot. This does not by itself raise the active-mutation concurrency limit.

source.originalText: | 5 | Mutation Slot II unlocked |

completeCard.name: Bone Hardened
completeCard.effect: While you are not Staggered, reduce physical weapon damage you take by 1 after resistance and before temporary HP.

source.originalText: | 6 | Bone Hardened: DR +1 while not staggered |

completeCard.name: Divine Smite
completeCard.effect: Divine Smite. Tags: smite, divine. Make a Cleric technique attack against one enemy. On a hit, deal S d8 + M radiant damage. This is one damage event. Invocation Path bonuses and features explicitly referring to Smite may modify it.

source.originalText: Divine Smite: Channel divine energy into a powerful strike against a single enemy, dealing damage based on your Wisdom and consuming 1 Conviction.

completeCard.name: Healing Rite
completeCard.effect: Healing Rite. Tags: rite, healing. One living ally regains S d8 + M HP. It cannot restore a dead creature or remove Wounds. Consecrated Ground and appropriate Invocation Path bonuses may modify this healing.

source.originalText: Healing Rite: A channeled ability that restores health to an ally, with increased effectiveness on consecrated ground.

completeCard.name: Conviction Pool
completeCard.effect: Conviction Pool. Tags: conviction, passive. Increase your Conviction maximum by 2. This changes only the maximum; it does not immediately restore spent Conviction when acquired during play. A long rest restores Conviction to the new maximum.

source.originalText: Conviction Pool: +2 max Conviction cap.

completeCard.name: Consecrated Ground
completeCard.effect: Consecrated Ground. Tags: rite, healing, passive. Whenever one of your healing Rites restores HP to a living creature standing in terrain created by your Consecrate feature, that creature regains S additional HP. Apply this once per creature per Rite pulse; it is flat healing and is not itself another healing trigger.

source.originalText: Consecrated Ground: Healing allies on terrain you sanctify (via Rite) heals for +10%.

completeCard.name: Judging Light
completeCard.effect: Judging Light. Tags: smite, passive. When your Divine Smite damages a creature currently affected by a Cursed or Weakened condition, add S d4 radiant damage to that Smite. Roll these dice once as part of the Smite; they do not create a second hit or trigger.

source.originalText: Judging Light: Smite deals +20% bonus damage to enemies afflicted by Cursed or Weakened effects.

completeCard.name: Fervent Ritualist
completeCard.effect: Fervent Ritualist. Tags: rite, ritual, passive. When a Rite with a Ritual activation normally requires at least 10 minutes, reduce its required time by 1 minute for each full 10 minutes of its printed casting time. This never reduces a Ritual below 1 minute and does not alter Action, Bonus Action or Reaction Rites.

source.originalText: Fervent Ritualist: +10% faster channel speed on all Rites.

completeCard.name: Divine Invocation
completeCard.effect: Divine Invocation. Tags: invocation, bishop. Use only your selected Invocation Path. Radiance: up to 3 allies within 30 feet each regain S d8+M HP; one may end Frightened or Poisoned. Judgment: one enemy within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save, taking (S+1)d8 radiant on failure or half on success; failure also applies Judged for 2 rounds. Renewal: up to 2 allies within 30 feet each regain S d8+M HP and 5 Stamina. Flame: creatures in a 15-foot cone make Dexterity saves, taking (S+1)d8 fire on failure or half on success; failed targets also take 1d6 fire at the start of their next turn. Veil: up to 3 allies within 30 feet can see invisible/ethereal creatures within 30 feet and gain advantage on saves against illusions for 3 rounds. Echoes: choose one eligible Smite or Rite you resolved this turn or previous regular turn and one original target within 30 feet; repeat 50% of its immediate unmodified rolled damage or healing dice, rounded down once, minimum 1 for a positive source, with no copied conditions, resources or triggers.

source.originalText: Divine Invocation: Channel a powerful prayer based on your chosen Invocation Path, with effects ranging from mass healing to divine fire or protective barriers.

completeCard.name: Aura of Faith
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: Allies within 15 feet who can perceive you
completeCard.effect: Aura of Faith. Tags: aura, bishop. Allies in the aura gain +1 on saving throws. Whenever your Rite restores HP to an ally in the aura, that ally also regains 1 additional HP. Multiple Aura of Faith bonuses do not stack.

source.originalText: Aura of Faith: Allies in range gain +5% healing received and +1 to saves.

completeCard.name: Sacred Chant
completeCard.effect: Sacred Chant. Tags: chant, sustained, conviction. Pulse on start and once when maintained on each later regular turn with a Bonus Action. Under the base feature, the third pulse generates 1 Conviction. Only a real encounter can generate Conviction this way. Maintenance itself does not otherwise heal, damage or grant Conviction.

source.originalText: Sacred Chant: A sustained prayer that generates 1 Conviction every 3 turns while maintained.

completeCard.name: Consecrate
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: 15-foot-radius fixed zone centered at a point within 30 feet
completeCard.effect: Consecrate. Tags: rite, zone. Create sanctified terrain. Your Consecrated Ground feature recognizes this zone. Undead creatures in the zone have -1 on attack rolls. A creature leaving the zone loses that penalty immediately. Only one Consecrate zone created by you may exist at a time; creating another ends the first.

source.originalText: Consecrate: Sanctify the ground in a 15-foot radius, creating consecrated terrain that enhances your healing abilities and weakens undead enemies.

completeCard.name: Divine Insight
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: Self; subject matter concerning a religious matter, sacred location or divine presence
completeCard.effect: Divine Insight. Tags: ritual, information. Ask the Director one specific factual question about a religious practice, sacred location, divine presence or recognized supernatural sign available to your tradition. Receive one truthful fact, symbolic clue or 'unknown' if the information is genuinely unavailable. This never forces certainty about future events or another character's private beliefs.

source.originalText: Divine Insight: Commune briefly with your deity to gain insight about a religious matter, sacred location, or divine presence.

completeCard.name: Sermon of Purpose
completeCard.effect: Sermon of Purpose. Tags: chant, conviction, bishop. Sacred Chant generates its 1 Conviction on its second pulse instead of its third. A normal three-pulse Sacred Chant still generates only 1 Conviction total unless another feature explicitly extends it or grants an additional generation event.

source.originalText: Sermon of Purpose: Chants now generate 1 Conviction every 2 turns.

completeCard.name: Liturgical Flow
completeCard.effect: Liturgical Flow. Tags: rite, invocation, recharge. If you start Rites on two consecutive regular turns, your next Divine Invocation started before the end of your following regular turn sets its printed round-recharge counter 1 lower, minimum 0. This counts as Divine Invocation's one allowed reset or shortening for that round.

source.originalText: Liturgical Flow: Chaining 2 Rites reduces cooldown of your next Invocation by 1 turn.

completeCard.name: Anointed Guardian
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: First ally within 30 feet to fall to one-quarter maximum HP or less
completeCard.effect: Anointed Guardian. Tags: protection, bishop. The first qualifying ally in an encounter gains a ward for 2 rounds. The first time during each round that ally takes damage, reduce that damage by PB + M, minimum 0. The ward does not prevent conditions attached to an attack unless the damage reduction itself invalidates them under another rule.

source.originalText: Anointed Guardian: First time an ally drops below 20% HP per combat, grant them a 30% damage reduction shield for 2 rounds.

completeCard.name: Invocation Attunement
completeCard.effect: Invocation Attunement. Tags: invocation, core. At Cleric level 2 choose exactly one Invocation Path: Radiance, Judgment, Renewal, Flame, Veil or Echoes. You automatically gain that path's listed bonus. Divine Invocation thereafter uses that path's mode unless another feature explicitly overrides it.

source.originalText: Invocation Attunement: Choose one Invocation Path (see below); gain a permanent passive tied to it.

completeCard.name: Bishop's Mandate
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: Your Sacrament and one legal Divine Invocation target set
completeCard.frequency: Automatic at Cleric 9; once per Sacrament start
completeCard.effect: Bishop's Mandate. Tags: sacrament, invocation, capstone. When you legally start Sacrament, immediately resolve one free Divine Invocation using your selected Invocation Path. This free Invocation requires no Action, RP or Conviction, sets no Divine Invocation recharge and cannot itself trigger Bishop's Mandate. The Sacrament's own Conviction expenditure may still vent Dissonance normally.

source.originalText: Capstone: Bishop's Mandate: Activating a Sacrament automatically casts a free Invocation without cost or cooldown.

completeCard.name: Judgment
completeCard.frequency: Automatic only if Judgment was selected
completeCard.effect: Invocation Path — Judgment. Tags: invocation, judgment, smite. When your Divine Smite deals damage to a creature, mark it Judged for 2 rounds. A Judged creature has -1 AC. Further applications refresh the duration but do not increase the AC penalty.

source.originalText: Judgment: Smites mark enemies with Judged for 2 rounds, reducing their AC by 1.

source.originalText:
Druidic
You know Druidic, the secret language of druids. You can speak the language and use it to leave hidden messages. You and others who know this language automatically spot such a message. Others spot the message's presence with a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check but can't decipher it without magic.

source.originalText:
Spellcasting
Drawing on the essence of nature itself, you can cast spells to shape that essence to your will. See chapter 10 for the general rules of spellcasting and chapter 11 for the druid spell list.
Cantrips
At 1st level, you know two cantrips of your choice from the druid spell list. You learn additional druid cantrips of your choice at higher levels, as shown in the Cantrips Known column of the Druid table.
Preparing and Casting Spells
The Druid table shows how many Resonance Points you have to cast your druid spells. A spell's base RP cost is twice its Resonance Rank (Rank 0 cantrips cost 0), modified by explicit class features and current Dissonance. You regain expended RP according to the Resonance recovery rules.
You prepare the list of druid spells that are available for you to cast, choosing from the druid spell list. When you do so, choose a number of druid spells equal to your Wisdom modifier + your druid level (minimum of one spell). The spells must be of a level for which you have Resonance Points.
For example, if you are a 3rd-level druid, you have 7 Resonance Points. With a Wisdom of 16, your list of prepared spells can include six spells, and they can be of 1st or 2nd level in any combination. If you prepare the Rank 1 spell cure wounds, its base cost is 2 Resonance Points before explicit specialization or Dissonance modifiers. Casting the spell doesn't remove it from your list of prepared spells.
You can change your list of prepared spells when you finish a long rest. Preparing a new list of druid spells requires time spent in prayer and meditation: at least 1 minute per spell level for each spell on your list.
Spellcasting Ability
Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for your druid spells, since your magic draws upon your devotion and attunement to nature. You use your Wisdom whenever a spell refers to your spellcasting ability. In addition, you use your Wisdom modifier when setting the saving throw DC for a druid spell you cast and when making an attack roll with one.
Spell save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier
Spell attack modifier = your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier
Ritual Casting
You can cast a druid spell as a ritual if that spell has the ritual tag and you have the spell prepared.

Spellcasting Focus
You can use a druidic focus as a spellcasting focus for your druid spells.

source.originalText:
Shapeshifting
At 1st level, you gain the ability to transform into various animal forms. Shapeshifting is Aethel's native druidic transformation discipline and functions according to the following rules:

Activation and Duration
You can use a bonus action to assume a beast form. You can remain in beast form for 10 minutes per use. You then revert to your normal form unless you expend another use of this feature. You can revert to your normal form earlier by using a bonus action on your turn.

Uses per Day
At 1st level, you can use your Shapeshifting ability twice per long rest. You gain additional uses as you reach higher levels, as shown in the Shapeshifting Uses column of the Druid table.

Available Forms
At 1st level, you can transform into any of the Base Druid Forms listed below. At 11th level, you gain access to Arch Druid Forms. At 10th level, you gain access to Hero Druid Forms specific to your chosen Circle.
Limitations While Transformed
While in beast form:
You cannot cast spells unless specified by your Hero Class
Your ability to speak is limited (only preserved in arch/hero forms)
You retain your mental ability scores (Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma)
You gain the physical traits of the chosen form as specified

completeCard.name: Mirrorbind
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: One eligible witnessed creature within 60 ft
completeCard.effect: Apply the engine's exact capture procedure: WIS save or store a bounded profile for the witnessed ability. State category/rank before save. Success prevents capture but consumes attempt; no target can be mirrored outside eligibility restrictions.

source.originalText: Mirrorbind: Attempt to capture an ability you've just witnessed, storing it in an Echo Slot if successful.

completeCard.name: Echo Release
completeCard.cost: Recorded rank RP cost; consume 1 Echo
completeCard.effect: Resolve the stored Strike/Burst/Mend/Ward/Hindrance profile, using current S and INT. Pay before release; empty slot even if resisted. First release ignores only Refrain addition. No original source extra actions/resources/procs.

source.originalText: Echo Release: Cast a stored Echo ability, consuming the slot.

completeCard.name: Reflective Pulse
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: Attacker within 30 ft after its first hit this round damages you
completeCard.effect: Deal psychic damage equal to min(M, damage actually taken). This cannot critically hit, trigger another reflection, generate resources or prevent the original damage. No effect if you take 0.

source.originalText: Reflective Pulse: First hit you take each round returns 10% damage.

completeCard.name: Mirrorcall
completeCard.effect: Beast gains+M maximum/current HP when summoned and+5 ft Speed. Echo Release or Mirror Beast Summon already provides its base procedure; this is an optional enhancement, not a second required unlock.

source.originalText: Mirrorcall: Summon a Mirror Beast that mimics one stored Echo ability.

completeCard.name: Echo Slot Expansion I
completeCard.effect: If an ordinary slot is full, replace one record while preserving its name/profile in an inert backup. Once before next long rest, after a slot empties, restore that backup without an Action. Total usable records remain at your capacity; backup cannot be cast directly or backed up again. An inert backup counts toward the absolute six-record archive ceiling. A backup cannot be created if usable records plus inert backups would exceed six.

source.originalText: Echo Slot Expansion I: Increase slots from 2 → 3.

completeCard.name: Mirror Beast Summon
completeCard.effect: Summon one standard Mirror Beast; replaces any prior Beast/Reflective Companion. Choose appearance of a stored source. It attacks only on Bonus Action command or originates your paid release with Action+command, never both. No copied anatomy, regeneration or immortality.

source.originalText: Mirror Beast Summon: Call forth a Mirror Beast that can use one of your stored Echo abilities.

completeCard.name: Reflective Analysis
completeCard.effect: Learn whether it is capture-eligible and one visible ability's bounded profile/rank before attempting. The next Mirrorbind save it makes against you has-1. Nonstacking; does not reveal private thoughts or permit boss copying.

source.originalText: Reflective Analysis: Study a creature to gain insight into its abilities and weaknesses, increasing your chance to successfully bind its Echoes.

completeCard.name: Echo Slot Expansion II
completeCard.effect: Ordinary Echo storage capacity becomes 5, replacing 3. Restricted extra slots still obey total 6. New slots are empty; the feature creates no Echo records or spell access.

source.originalText: Echo Slot Expansion II: Max Echo Slots: 5

completeCard.name: Charm Creature
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: One eligible INT 6-or-lower creature within 30 ft
completeCard.effect: WIS save or become Reflective Companion under engine restrictions. It repeats save at turn end and when harmed by your side. Replaces Mirror Beast; on end original disposition returns. Requires no suicidal orders; cannot force beliefs or permanently enslave.

source.originalText: Charm Creature: Attempt to temporarily charm a low-intelligence creature to fight alongside you.

completeCard.name: Dual Echo Cast
completeCard.cost: RP for each of 2 Echoes; consume both
completeCard.effect: Release two records captured from different creatures as ONE combined release. Each deals/heals half its profile's rolled amount, round once per component. At most one Hindrance rider; no duplicated resources or additional release this round.

source.originalText: Dual Echo Cast: Spend 2 Echoes in one turn; must be from different creatures.

completeCard.name: Mimicry Focus
completeCard.effect: At genuine encounter start gain 1 Focus Point, cap 1; any previous point is replaced. Spend on Focus Channel or pay 1 Focus during a release to add 1d6 to one damage/healing target. No point generation from staged combat.

source.originalText: Mimicry Focus: Gain +1 Focus Point per battle. Can spend Focus to empower Echoes (double duration/damage).

completeCard.name: Advanced Mirrorcall
completeCard.effect: You may change Beast appearance to another stored source as a Bonus Action without resummoning or restoring HP. It gains either+10 ft swim or climb Speed until it ends. No new release, attack or capture.

source.originalText: Advanced Mirrorcall: Mirror Beast can now shift once per fight into a new form based on a second Echo.

completeCard.name: Beast Instinct
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: A failed Mirrorbind against eligible INT 6-or-lower source
completeCard.effect: Force that target to reroll its successful save; use the second result. Eligibility, line of effect and an empty slot still required. Does not create a second captured record or a new encounter attempt.

source.originalText: Beast Instinct: +10% chance to capture Echoes from INT ≤ 6 creatures.

completeCard.name: Mirror Shell
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: A hostile spell targeting only you within 60 ft
completeCard.effect: After a successful save against the spell or after its spell attack misses, choose its caster; it makes WIS save or takes S d8 force. Original damage/control follow normal results. No copying arbitrary spell text or redirecting an area spell.

source.originalText: Mirror Shell: Once per long rest, reflect the first ability cast at you.

completeCard.name: Mirror Image
completeCard.effect: Create two decoys. When an attack hits you, use Reaction to erase one and impose disadvantage on that attack's reroll. Decoys do not cast, attack, intercept area damage or create Echo records. At most one decoy erased per round.

source.originalText: Mirror Image: Create multiple illusory duplicates of yourself that can confuse enemies and potentially cast Echo abilities.

completeCard.name: Floating Memory Slot
completeCard.effect: Capacity becomes 6 if below 6; temporary slot is erased at encounter end. If already 6, choose one existing slot instead and its release gains+5 ft range. Never exceed 6 or preserve a seventh via a backup.

source.originalText: Floating Memory Slot: Temporarily store a 6th Echo. Auto-erases after combat.

completeCard.name: Perfect Reflection
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: Creature within 60 ft whose observed ability targets you
completeCard.effect: Reduce triggering damage to you by(S+1)d8+M, minimum 0. If any is prevented, source makes WIS save or takes that prevented amount as force, maximum 30. This is your release action for the round; no reflected conditions or legendary powers. Cannot recursively reflect.

source.originalText: Capstone – Perfect Reflection: Reflect any observed ability (spell, breath, strike) back at the caster for full effect (1/day).

source.originalText: Divine Reflection: Capture and enhance beneficial abilities, increasing their healing or protective power.

completeCard.effect: Add one slot usable only for Mend or Ward, total storage cap 6. If already at 6, designate one existing slot sacred instead; once/short rest its release costs 1 less RP, minimum 1. No duplicate slot or free record.

source.originalText: Sacred Echo Slot: +1 additional slot for healing/support abilities.
